description: This Java class defines a REST controller for authentication operations, including user registration and login, issuing JWT tokens in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: REST controller handling user authentication endpoints, including registration and login, returning JWT tokens.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration by accepting registration details, invoking the authService to register the user, and returning a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login by accepting authentication details, invoking the authService to authenticate the user, and returning a JWT token upon success.
